prompts.c3a38baca9ba5fb5d7636b13ccf2434dda17d9dd:
You are given one medical image. Write a structured visual observation of this image.
Rules:
- Describe only what is visible in this image. Do not give a diagnosis or a disease name.
- If an item cannot be judged from this single image, write "not assessable". Not assessable does not mean absent.
- Do not state that the whole examination is normal. Do not give sizes in units, signal or sequence names, contrast phase, or change over time unless directly visible.
- State side as it appears in the image (image-left or image-right) unless orientation markers are visible.
Image context: computed tomography (CT), cross-sectional; body region: abdomen and pelvis.
Report each item below on its own line, in this exact format:
<item number>. <item name> | <visible / partly visible / not visible / not assessable> | <short observation, at most 25 words>
Items:
1. Window and contrast: displayed window (soft tissue, lung or bone) and whether contrast is visible
2. Liver: contour, size, enhancement pattern, focal lesions and visible hepatic vessels
3. Gallbladder and bile ducts: gallbladder, intrahepatic ducts and common bile duct calibre
4. Pancreas: contour, enhancement, focal lesions and duct calibre
5. Spleen: size impression, enhancement and focal lesions
6. Adrenal glands: shape and any focal mass on each side
7. Kidneys, ureters and bladder: kidney contour, enhancement, masses, stones, collecting system, ureters and bladder wall
8. Stomach and bowel: gastro-oesophageal junction, stomach, duodenum, bowel calibre, wall and appendix
9. Peritoneal cavity: free fluid, fluid collections, free air and peritoneal nodules
10. Blood vessels: aorta, inferior vena cava, portal and mesenteric veins, visceral and iliac vessels
11. Lymph nodes: enlarged nodes by region: lower chest, upper abdominal, retroperitoneal, mesenteric, pelvic, inguinal
12. Lower chest: visible lung bases and any pleural or pericardial fluid
13. Pelvic organs: visible uterus and ovaries, or prostate and seminal vesicles
14. Bones and body wall: visible spine, pelvis and ribs, muscles and abdominal wall
Write nothing before item 1 and nothing after the last item.
